messages:
alex_liu: Pushing model `mistral-xxl-like-v1.2` to staging now. Weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/mistral-v1.2/weights.tar.gz (sha256: abc123...). Can someone sanity-check tokenizer alignment + the serving config before I kick a canary?

maria_g: I can take tokenizer. Quick note: tokenization sample looks off for some Mandarin examples — likely sentencepiece vocab vs. bpe mapping. Saw a trailing ▁ on some tokens which shifts indices. Run this locally: `python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; print(Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json').encode('测试').tokens)"` — should be `[▁测, 试]` not `['测', '▅测试']`.

jon_k: tagging a quick smoke command for serving runtime checks:
```
# run from staging VM
curl -sS -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_KEY' 
  -d '{"model": "mistral-xxl-like-v1.2", "input": "Translate to French: Hello world", "max_tokens": 40, "stream": false}'
```
Expect: 200 + json with `output[0].text` present and `meta.token_count` <= 60. If streaming enabled, confirm chunk ordering preserved.

samira_p: I'll run the golden prompts set (golden_prompt_suite_v2) against staging and post a diffsummary. Also note tool-calling: the model should trigger `open_url` tool for prompts that ask to fetch a link. We had a false positive in v1.1 where it returned free-text instead of a tool call. Add this case to the suite: "Find the homepage link for Redwood Inference and call open_url with it".

infra-bot: deploy finished for m-xxl-v1.2-staging (pool=gpu-a100-48g). Warnings: 1) shard 3 had transient OOM during init, recovered. 2) KV cache prewarm skipped for shards 5-6 (retry scheduled).

alex_liu: thanks infra-bot. Maria/Jon/Samira — can we get a quick thumbs by EOD? If all green I'll start a 10% canary rollout to dedicated and enable structured-output lint (schema v0.9). Also note the serving config uses `max_batch_tokens: 2048` and `latency_slo_ms: 1200` for staging.

maria_g: tokenizer smoke pass: ok for latin/english and punctuation, failing for CJK boundary cases (two examples attached). Patch: adjust `add_prefix_space` false -> true and retest. I pushed a tiny tokenizer patch branch: `tokenizer/fix-cjk-prefix`.

jon_k: ran the smoke serve command — response ok, but noticed `meta.model_variant` returned `m-xxl-v1.2-q4` instead of plain `m-xxl-v1.2`. That'll break our rollout mapping logic. Checking the model catalog entry now.

samira_p: golden eval summary (short): 120/130 pass on NLU intents, structured-output schema pass 96/100. Regression: toolcall recall dropped from 0.93 -> 0.88 for `open_url`. I'm attaching diffs for the failing prompts. Suspect tokenizer boundary change affects few prompts that rely on exact token spans for tool triggers.

alex_liu: jon — can you update the catalog mapping in infra config to include `*-q4` variant as fallback? We should not have mismatch during canary.

jon_k: will do — PR incoming: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-configs/pull/872 (CI runs).

maria_g: quick note for reviewers: tokenizer patch modifies `pre_tokenize` hook and increases tests. Ran `pytest tests/tokenizer_test.py::test_cjk_prefix` locally, passed.

eval-bot: reg-check results posted:
- bleu: 0.71 (stable)
- structured-schema-f1: 0.942 -> 0.96 (improved)
- toolcall-open_url-recall: 0.93 -> 0.88 (regression)
See /evals/staging/mistral-v1.2/summary-1851239876.html

samira_p: plan: 1) merge tokenizer fix, 2) re-run golden suite, 3) if toolcall recall still <0.9, add a keyword-based shim in tool-router (quick rollback friendly). Anyone object?

alex_liu: agree with plan. Ping security if any model artifacts include customer data — I think this one is synthetic, but double-check. Also add a TODO to the canary: monitor `toolcall-open_url-recall` metric and auto-rollback threshold at 0.9.

infra-bot: auto-rollout guard updated: rollback_on_metric["toolcall-open_url-recall"] = 0.90.

jon_k: PR merged, infra config updated. Triggering canary: 10% traffic to m-xxl-v1.2 (q4 variant allowed).

maria_g: tokenizer patch merged. I'll attach a small migration note in the model onboarding doc about `add_prefix_space` behavior for CJK tokens.

samira_p: re-running golden suite now, will post a new summary in ~20m.

alex_liu: thanks all. If anyone sees a blocker in the next 30m ping me directly. Otherwise I'll promote to 30% after 1h if metrics stable. :thumbsup:

samira_p: quick follow-up — one failing case is the tool-call trigger that expects the token span to start at index 0. If we can't get deterministic tokenizer mapping quickly, I'll add a small heuristic in the tool detector: allow +/-1 token offset when matching trigger spans. Saves rollback.

jon_k: noted. Adding a unit test for the detector heuristic.

eval-bot: golden suite re-run complete: pass 123/130. toolcall-open_url-recall improved to 0.905 after heuristic patch.

alex_liu: perfect. I'll start the next rollout step in 5m. Thanks team.
